sense: of a phone or a program

terms.gloss: choices: the settings of a phone or a program
evidence: Cic. Fat. 2.3: utrō fruī mālīs, optiō sit tua (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically optiō is a choice, the freedom to choose; its use in the plural for the menu of choices on a phone or a computer is modern, and ours. No reference work has a word for settings.

phrases.english: Open the settings and turn the volume down.

sources: Lewis & Short: optio
